Secondary pigmentary degeneration of the retina; no specific infectious or immune mechanism is inherent to this concept.

Generalized atherosclerotic arterial disease; downstream infarctions and organ-specific ischemic diseases are separately diagnosed complications.
Glucokinase deficiency causes permanent neonatal insulin-secretory failure; this genetic diabetes is not autoimmune.
Genetic epilepsy with intellectual disability in 16/25. Nystagmus does not establish ocular tissue damage; facial dysmorphism alone adds no axis.
KIF12-associated intrahepatic cholestatic disease with fibrosis in 4/5. Pruritus does not establish skin damage; secondary lipid elevation adds no metabolic axis.
Carcinoma confined to urinary bladder urothelium; bladder belongs to the renal axis.
Copper transport disorder; seizures and acne 30-79%, immune dysfunction 80-99%; seborrheic dermatitis also described. Anemia and skeletal abnormalities 5-29%.
Neurological disturbance of sensory localization; no separate sensory-organ damage is established.
Malignant neuroendocrine tumor of autonomic paraganglia in the jugular/tympanic region. Vascularity and skull-base location do not establish vascular or bone origin.
Congenital lacrimal and salivary gland deficiency directly impairs tear and saliva production; salivary glands and teeth belong to gastrointestinal.
Defined focal epilepsy syndrome, despite its transient and generally benign course.
Skeletal myopathy with progressive weakness and contractural or skeletal changes. Cardiomyopathy occurs in 5-29%; respiratory muscle weakness does not establish pulmonary damage.
GLUT1 glucose-transport disorder causing dystonia and progressive pyramidal dysfunction. Diplopia reflects neurologic dysfunction without established ocular damage.
